title: Reports
summary: Requesting PDFs and waiting for them to finish.

paragraphs.text: Reports run asynchronously—you submit a job, and the list shows queued, running, or completed. Refresh or watch the notification bell; when a report is ready, open it and download the PDF.
Each report type asks for different parameters (dates, accounts, etc.). If a job fails, try again with a narrower range or check that your chart of accounts has what that report needs.
